notes: Of the 11 initial high-severity npm audit advisories, 6 advisories in the electron-builder / @electron/rebuild / node-gyp / app-builder-lib / dmg-builder / electron-builder-squirrel-windows chain were permanently eliminated via deterministic dependency resolution. The remaining 5 advisories all stem from a single upstream advisory (GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf in picomatch <= 4.0.7, which is currently the newest version published on the npm registry) used as a build-time dependency of Vite.

exceptions.fixAvailable: No upstream patched version > 4.0.7 exists on the npm registry as of 2026-11-17 (dist-tag latest = 4.0.7)
exceptions.winhoodImpact: Build-time frontend bundling only. Not used by WinHood SAST/SCA/SBOM analyzers, server.ts API routes, or untrusted project ingestion.
exceptions.justification: picomatch 4.0.7 is the latest published version on npm; downgrading Vite to <= 6.4.3 introduces 12 actual Vite path-traversal and WebSocket file-read vulnerabilities (GHSA-p9ff-h696-f583, GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9).
exceptions.compensatingControl: WinHood never passes user-supplied glob patterns to picomatch; project file discovery uses deterministic fs.readdirSync traversal with strict path confinement and symlink rejection.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove override/exception immediately upon publication of picomatch >= 4.0.8 on npm.

exceptions.winhoodImpact: Build-time Vite asset bundling only; not invoked at runtime on analyzed target repositories.

exceptions.compensatingControl: Restricted to static frontend build pipeline over trusted repository source files.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove immediately upon publication of picomatch >= 4.0.8 on npm.
